newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: VICOM says to expand to meet competition.
newsitem.headline: VICOM says to expand to meet competition.

text.p: Vehicle inspection firm VICOM Ltd said on Thursday a 36.8 percent fall in its half-year profit was a result of new entrants eroding its market share.
VICOM said in a statement it expected similar competition in the second half of its financial year, but added that an expansion programme was already in place to counter this.
The company said it expected full-year profits to remain satisfactory, barring unforeseen circumstances.
VICOM earlier reported a net profit for the six months to September 30, 1996, of Singapore $0.96 million, down from S$1.52 million in the same period the year before.
VICOM said the opening of a third inspection centre would consolidate its position in the market. New ventures would also contribute positively to its profits in the next financial year.
VICOM said it was actively seeking new revenue sources to achieve sustainable growth.
